taskTitle: lfc-bot: an over-long digest must be split across several Discord messages without losing a line or advancing the watermark on a partial failure

acceptance.detail: Tests  6 failed | 7 passed (13) - returns a digest that fits as a single message; splits a long digest into messages under the limit without losing a line; starts a new message at a section heading rather than splitting a section that fits; hard-splits a single line longer than the limit instead of dropping it; sends a digest longer than one message as several, each within the limit; leaves the watermark unchanged when a later message fails, so nothing is dropped; (6 failed)
